assumptions: Lifecycle selection is navigation only; it never changes the editable process or Preview target.
Central-draft synchronization is intentionally unavailable until divergence signaling is implemented.
expected_behavior: Exactly one of Prototype or Automation is WORKING; the other is FROZEN.
Publication is an immutable PUBLISHED snapshot and never the mutable process.
Show in Preview explicitly chooses a supported Lifecycle snapshot.
Publication exposes checkpoint, release validation, publish, and delete; it never overwrites DEV from Root.
preview: Preview headings use proto:, active:, or public: prefixes.
risks: Returning to Prototype runs a guarded LLM adaptation and is asynchronous.
